testcase: MB-75507: plan stability PREPARED_ONLY, error policy FLEXIBLE
statements: UPDATE system:settings SET plan_stability.mode = "prepared only", plan_stability.error_policy = "flexible"

testcase: MB-75507: an index to be dropped
statements: CREATE INDEX mb75507_idx ON shellTest(c11, c12, c21) WHERE type = "left"

testcase: MB-75507: prepared statement using the index, saved
statements: PREPARE mb75507_p1 FROM SELECT c11 FROM shellTest USE INDEX (mb75507_idx) WHERE type = "left" AND c11 > 2 ORDER BY c11

testcase: MB-75507: back up the saved plan
statements: INSERT INTO QUERY_METADATA._system._query (KEY k, VALUE v) SELECT "mb75507_backup" AS k, {"origId": meta(d).id, "doc": d} AS v FROM QUERY_METADATA._system._query d USE KEYS "ppn::mb75507_p1"
